rationale: Verified reviewed commit f3488f95 with git show --stat and full-patch inspection. The changes are confined to prose: two ADR documents and comments in internal/complete/complete.go; no executable Go statements, tests, configuration, or protocol behavior changed. Spot-checked the reworded step-2.25 ordering rationale against the surrounding implementation: panelGate executes before the prospective-snapshot/materialization section, and runMaterialization remains the materialization entry point. The one disclosed extra ADR-0041 correction accurately describes reconcile as a read-only committed-range gate path and is likewise prose-only. My prior APPROVE verdict therefore stands.

findings.title: Round-4 fix is confined to documentation and comments
findings.evidence: git show f3488f95 --stat reports exactly three modified files: ADR-0037, ADR-0041, and internal/complete/complete.go. Full-patch inspection shows only Markdown prose and Go comments changed; executable code is byte-identical across the commit.

findings.title: Step-2.25 ordering prose matches delivered control flow
findings.evidence: In internal/complete/complete.go, panelGate returns or passes before the step-2.26 preflight and the step-2.5-3.5 prospective-snapshot section; runMaterialization is called only afterward on the non-reconcile path. The revised comment correctly replaces retired CommitAll terminology without changing the load-bearing ordering claim.

findings.title: R5 standing approval remains valid
findings.evidence: Because f3488f95 changes no runtime or test behavior, the protocol and verification basis underlying R5's prior APPROVE verdict are unchanged.
